overview.description: The PGIM Jennison Small-Mid Cap Core Equity ETF (PJSM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in extended market equity. The fund invests in small- and mid-cap US companies through an actively managed portfolio. Securities are selected through proprietary fundamental research combined with a quantitative process. PJSM was launched on Sep 1, 2026 and is issued by PGIM.
